portfolio_reconciliation.statement: Each quarter's totals are compared against the sum of every partition of them. A partition that does not add back to the whole is describing a different population from the one the headline is about.

rating_distribution.statement: Every governed grade appears, including any with no borrowers on it. A distribution that omits an empty grade reads as though the scale stops there.

spot_check.statement: Ten borrowers, stratified across Stage and sector on a fixed seed rather than chosen, followed across every quarter they are on book. Each row shows the product the provision is, so a reader can check it with a calculator.
